items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: And, uh, so he hired me to play with him that night. Down at Rice, that's where I started with the guitar.

ctx.x: What was your first job, Eddie? Do you remember?

Uh, let's see, I, I couldn't, let me first job, let's see. Oh yeah, first job, I'll tell you my first job. Our first job was with Kenneas Jackson. I played guitar. I was working at Thompson Sawmill. Where was that? Broad and Portis. I was working, working at Thompson Sawmill and I could play guitar, you know. I, I'll tell you how I played guitar. I wasn't, say, complimenting, you know, I could just, could pick the guitar, you know. And that time you'd pick it, pick it with your finger, you know, put a strap…
You see, Pete Lala was on Marais street.
